newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Spain, Tunisia sign a 21,800 million pesetas deal.
newsitem.headline: Spain, Tunisia sign a 21,800 million pesetas deal.

text.p: Tunisia and Spain signed a 21,800 million pesetas financial protocol aimed at boosting trade exchanges and partnership between the two countries, officials said on Wednesday.

They said the protocol was for a four-year period. The first tranche of 10,900 million pesetas will be disbursed during the first two years and the same amount would be for the second half of the period.

Each of the two equal amounts include a donation to finance economic studies for Tunisian firms, a credit to finance Spanish exports to Tunisia, a credit to support Tunisian and medium firms, a bank credit and a credit to promote joint ventures.
The agreement was signed in Tunis on Tuesday by Tunisian International Cooperation and Foreign Investment Mohamed Ghannouchi and Spanish Secretary of State for Trade and Tourism Fernandez Norniella.
